title: Sequential code-skipping action
statement: For natural numbers $k$ and $n$ and a Boolean list $xs$, apply the code-skipping operations in this order: skip a pair using the Boolean condition $a \lor \neg b$, repeat the work-skipping operation $k$ times, skip another pair using the same condition, and then skip a state encoding for $n+1$. The result is the remaining Boolean list if every operation succeeds, and no result if any operation fails.
caveat: The supplied statement does not include definitions of the pair, repeat, work, or state-skipping operations, so their exact meanings and failure conditions cannot be stated.
